claim: Model size alone is insufficient to ensure robust reasoning in LLMs; reasoning robustness is influenced more by architectural advancements and training strategies than by sheer scale.
falsifier: Evaluate a diverse set of LLMs of varying sizes and architectures on the NOTO variation and analyze the correlation between size and accuracy drop.

conditions: Range of models from different families and sizes
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported LLMs, datasets, and zero-shot setting; transfer beyond these conditions is unestablished.

title: Model size vs. architectural–Robustness to the NOTO principle
